title: Untitled (CDs and Warplanes) 1
description: Mixed-media collage densely layered with compact discs, top-down warplane silhouettes, concentric target rings, and an american football across a white ground. Red ribbon stripes run vertically through the composition, punctuated by a small photographic face, perforated dots, and iridescent disc surfaces.
composition: vertical stripes anchor layered disc clusters
